energy_adequacy.rationale: Measures total station electrical service coverage vs total requested demand

critical_load_resilience.rationale: High priority: zero tolerance for unserved life-safety and comms critical load

thermal_resilience.rationale: Measures indoor habitability margin above pipe freeze and health safety limits

generation_resilience.rationale: Evaluates N-1 generator redundancy and active operating headroom

storage_resilience.rationale: Measures deliverable battery reserve above minimum discharge cutoff

fuel_resilience.rationale: Measures days of fuel inventory remaining vs operational baseline

logistics_resilience.rationale: Measures capability to bridge the logistics gap until the next resupply event

renewable_resilience.rationale: Measures independence from and vulnerability to sudden solar/wind dropouts

recovery_resilience.rationale: Evaluates station capability and rate to restore depleted energy reserves

metadata.description: Authoritative multi-dimensional resilience index weights for Polaris-EMS Phase 7
